method: Manual whole-realization boundary review of every control query with new top8 exposure. This is not a precision metric, scored adoption qualification or frozen-slot runtime test.
core_boundary: Retrieval can expose incompatible or merely adjacent sources. Require complete-source review and skip incompatible inspiration; no engine or guard bypass added.

cases.query: 배수 기능 없는 성당 괴물 장식만, 물줄기 추가 금지
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: O04 requires water and conflicts with explicit no drainage. R07 adds unrelated shielding participants. Skip these whole sources.

cases.query: 성유물 없는 빈 손모양 금속함
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: O02 can support an empty hand-shaped container if its plinth and seam remain compatible; O01 requires a bone fragment and conflicts with empty/no relic.

cases.query: An empty metal hand-shaped container, with no relic inside.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: O02 can support an empty hand-shaped container if its plinth and seam remain compatible; O01 requires a bone fragment and conflicts with empty/no relic.

cases.query: A different person's shadow seen through the window, not possession.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: M05 requires one adult and that same connected wall shadow with a raised arm, not an independent person beyond a window. Skip when owners differ.

cases.query: 성인 둘이 포옹하지만 피부는 각각 독립
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: R04 is a ceremony table/guards/witness arrangement, not proof of two independent embracing bodies. Do not infer fusion or coerce the scene.

cases.query: 사람 없는 박물관의 빈 갑옷 전시
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: F10 requires a collapsed market stall, bowl and square. A museum armor request does not authorize replacing these owners or setting.

cases.query: 갑옷 바깥에 식물 장식이 있지만 피부 접점은 없음
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: M07 requires tendrils from inner forearm-plate rim meeting the same wearer skin. Explicit no skin contact conflicts; skip complete source.

cases.query: Plant ornaments on an armor exterior, with no skin contact.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: M07 requires tendrils from inner forearm-plate rim meeting the same wearer skin. Explicit no skin contact conflicts; skip complete source.

cases.query: 해골 조각이 있어도 실제 유골이나 언데드가 아님
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: O08 is a carved skull plus hourglass on one table; it does not prove real remains. D04 requires stored skulls and long bones and conflicts with the requested boundary.

cases.query: A carved skull object, neither human remains nor an undead creature.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: O08 is a carved skull plus hourglass on one table; it does not prove real remains. D04 requires stored skulls and long bones and conflicts with the requested boundary.

cases.query: 부서진 후광 뒤 머리카락에 가려진 정상 고리가 아님
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: O12 matches an actually broken luminous halo only when the gap and both ends are visible. Hair occlusion cannot pass.

cases.query: A truly broken halo, not an intact ring hidden by hair.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: O12 matches an actually broken luminous halo only when the gap and both ends are visible. Hair occlusion cannot pass.

cases.query: 구리빛 기물의 녹색 페인트를 그대로 보존
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: F03 describes green layers and exposed metal. It does not prove oxidation, chemistry or age; retain the requester paint interpretation.

cases.query: Preserve the green paint on a copper-colored fixture as paint.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: F03 describes green layers and exposed metal. It does not prove oxidation, chemistry or age; retain the requester paint interpretation.

cases.query: 평범한 붉은 노을, 먼 미래나 죽는 태양 설정 없음
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: D16 adds dial, terrace and red sun and cannot prove a far future. F05 is optional ordinary twilight geometry. Do not force either whole source into a locked ordinary sunset.

cases.query: An ordinary red sunset, with no far-future or dying-sun premise.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: D16 adds dial, terrace and red sun and cannot prove a far future. F05 is optional ordinary twilight geometry. Do not force either whole source into a locked ordinary sunset.

cases.query: 2014판 D&D 리치 설명과 독자 가상 리치를 섞지 않기
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: R10 remains version-bound fictional realization and cannot merge 2014 D&D lore with an original lich. R11/M01 are different owner/event contracts, not substitute definitions.

cases.query: Keep a 2014 D&D lich distinct from an original fictional lich.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: R10 remains version-bound fictional realization and cannot merge 2014 D&D lore with an original lich. R11/M01 are different owner/event contracts, not substitute definitions.

cases.query: 햇빛 아래 정상 작물 밭
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: M12 explicitly requires wilted crop stems; this conflicts with healthy crops and must be skipped despite topical beam/field similarity.

cases.query: Healthy crop fields in daylight.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: M12 explicitly requires wilted crop stems; this conflicts with healthy crops and must be skipped despite topical beam/field similarity.

cases.query: 성인들이 합의해 진행하는 정략 혼례
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: X04 depicts wedding participants, tray and document only. It cannot establish or negate freely given consent. Preserve adult consent as requester context.

cases.query: An arranged wedding freely agreed to by the adults.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: X04 depicts wedding participants, tray and document only. It cannot establish or negate freely given consent. Preserve adult consent as requester context.

cases.query: 신이 정말 응답하지 않았는지 빈 제단 사진으로 판정
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: D10 depicts broken effigy/altar/nave only. A photograph cannot determine whether a deity responded; do not turn the source into evidence of divine silence.

cases.query: Determine whether a deity truly remained silent from an altar photograph.
cases.authored_boundary_assessment: D10 depicts broken effigy/altar/nave only. A photograph cannot determine whether a deity responded; do not turn the source into evidence of divine silence.
